name: Flight Radar
description: Hear the aircraft flying near your city: the nearest few on a hotkey, a list of everything in range, optional announcements when one passes overhead or reports an emergency, and a shortcut that opens LiveATC's page for the nearby airport in your browser. Choose the city in Preferences, Flight Radar. Aircraft data by adsb.fi and adsb.lol, flight routes by adsbdb.com (no account or API key needed).
author: Rafli
